name: Model Icons
author: Jeffiest
description: Draws the menus' item and weapon icons from each item's own 3D model instead of the flat icon sheets.

settings.name: Key light
settings.description: The light from the upper left.

settings.name: Fill light
settings.description: The weak light from the lower right.

settings.name: Ambient light
settings.description: The light every side of the model gets.

settings.name: Smooth shading
settings.description: Crease angle in degrees the shading is smoothed across; 0 is the PS2's faceted look.

settings.name: Outline and shadow
settings.description: A black outline and drop shadow, as the original icons have.
